part.text:
Fixed. Summary:

**Root cause:** On a replica, the primary-link client has `c->user == NULL` (set in src/replication.c:2002 so it can do everything). `ACLLoadFromFile` (src/acl.c:2382) dereferences `c->user->name` for every connected client when remapping users after loading the ACL file, so `ACL LOAD` on a replica segfaults on the primary client. This NULL-user client was introduced after 7.2, matching the regression timeline.

**Fix:** Skip clients with a NULL `c->user` in the client-remapping loop of `ACLLoadFromFile` (src/acl.c:2380) — they aren't affected by ACL changes.

**Validation:**
- Reproduced the crash before the fix (SIGSEGV in `ACLLoadFromFile`, acl.c:2382); after the fix, `ACL LOAD` succeeds on the replica, users load correctly, and replication stays up.
- `unit/acl` passes, including "Test ACL LOAD works on replica".
- `unit/auth`, `unit/pubsub`, `unit/acl-v2`, and `integration/replication` all pass.
